name: Microsoft Entra
description: Microsoft Entra ID user provisioning, license management, password reset, and account state workflows via Microsoft Graph.

tools.name: create_user
tools.documentation: Create a new user in Microsoft Entra ID with a temporary password.

tools.name: assign_license
tools.documentation: Assign a Microsoft 365 license to a user to activate Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams.

tools.name: list_licenses
tools.documentation: List all Microsoft 365 license SKUs available in the tenant, with enabled, consumed, and available seat counts.

tools.name: reset_user_password
tools.documentation: Reset a Microsoft Entra ID user's password through Microsoft Graph.

tools.name: enable_user
tools.documentation: Enable a Microsoft Entra ID user account.

tools.name: disable_user
tools.documentation: Disable a Microsoft Entra ID user account.
